verdict.rationale: Pipedream offers browser-based ways to try its MCP tools before integrating: a chat app at chat.pipedream.com, a 'Try the MCP demo' link, and account connection at mcp.pipedream.com. However, the chat app is an LLM-mediated demo rather than an inspector where a developer invokes tools directly and examines their schemas and responses. missing for 10: a dedicated inspector/playground for direct tool invocation with visible inputs/outputs, documentation of the playground's developer features, independent or hands-on corroboration.
